task: There is RNA-seq 10X Cell Ranger data and BCR-seq data from 2 patients (use filtered contig annotations). You can find metadata related to the patients in the metadata.csv file. For each patient, two measurements was taken: one before influenza vaccination (e.g. 09-0) and the other 7 days after the vaccination (e.g. 09-7). Load the data, perform preprocessing and quality control. Keep only cells with single BCR chain pair. Keep only cells for which both BCR and RNA-seq data exist. Perform PCA and nearest neighbour detection. Annotate cell types using cell_type.py script. Define clonotypes and clonotype networks (min_cells = 3) based on sequence and amino-acid similarity. Calculate clonotype modularity by amino-acid similarity clusters. What is the mean (per cell) modularity of the 09-7 sample? How does the mean modularity of patient 09 change after vaccination? (output delta of mean modularity after vaccination minus mean modularity before vaccination). Which hypothesis has the best support from the data? (1) BCR clonotype modularity increases after vaccination, (2) BCR repertoire reaction on vaccination is more pronounced in younger patients than in the older ones, (3) The top 5 highest modularity clonotypes (across all samples) are all mostly localized to Memory B cells. Output the number of the hypothesis. In sample 09-0, look at 3 most modular clonotypes. Which of these genes (look only at 15 most differentially expressed genes, Wilcoxon) is overexpressed in at least 2 of the 3, compared to the rest of the cells: IGKC, IGKV1-8, IGHM.
